cue.heading: Suing federal officers
cue.text: A suit for money damages against federal officers who violated the Constitution, recognized in Bivens (1971). The Fifth Circuit sends claims like Maxwell’s to such a suit.
cue.source: Bivens, 403 U.S. 388 (1971) · Fifth Circuit opinion, Pet. App. 1.1
